Introduction

Neptune is the fourteenth subunit of tripleS. It is the third unit of the msnz project, where the 24 members of tripleS are each split up into four 6-member subunits.

The first member and leader, SeoYeon, was revealed on September 4, 2025. Over the following days, the group held a "Grand Gravity" to determine the next five members. The next member to be revealed was DaHyun, followed by NaKyoung, Nien, Kotone, and SeoAh.
